TGGR Lab, Translational Genetics and Genomics Research Laboratory

Genetics Institute · Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center

Research

We are dedicated to decipher the role of genetic diseases in our patients.

Our projects focus on the identification, characterization and functional analyses of novel human disease‑causing genes in order to elucidate the disease pathophysiology and potentially provide targets for personalized medicine.

Families come from the Genetics Institute at Tel Aviv Sourasky Medical Center, or by outside colleagues.

Tools

  • Pellaeon

    Talk to UCSF ChimeraX in plain English.

  • GPCompaRe

    Inactive and active contacts across 283 human Class A GPCRs.

  • CO₂ monitor

    An incubator CO₂ and temperature monitor you build on an ESP32.

  • GeNest

    Finds genes that sit inside other genes, across a genome.
